title: ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines
excerpt: The agent running on a remote machine can authenticate using your local SSH credentials.
content_html:
ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines
207 points by DenGorbachev 21 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 73 comments

The agent running on a remote machine can authenticate using your local SSH credentials.

That means it can push to your private repos on GitHub, for example.

Proof: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/28131#discussion_r3410013180
